commands.name: Warm Greeting
commands.description: Friendly opener for any inbound message
commands.template: Hi {{name}}, thanks for reaching out! I'm happy to help you today. Let me look into this for you right away.

commands.name: Request More Information
commands.description: Politely ask for the details needed to help

commands.name: Follow-Up Check-In
commands.description: Check back after a previous interaction
commands.template:
Hi {{name}},

I wanted to follow up on your recent inquiry about {{topic}}. Has everything been resolved to your satisfaction?

If you have any remaining questions or need further assistance, please don't hesitate to reach out — I'm here to help.

commands.name: Transfer to Specialist
commands.description: Let the customer know they're being handed off
commands.template:
Hi {{name}},

Thank you for your patience. I've reviewed your request and I'd like to connect you with {{specialist_team}}, who are best equipped to assist with {{issue}}.

I'm passing along all the details we've discussed so you won't need to repeat yourself. You should hear from them within {{timeframe}}.

Is there anything else I can help clarify before the handoff?

commands.name: Friendly Close
commands.description: Wrap up a resolved ticket warmly
commands.template:
Hi {{name}},

I'm glad we were able to get this sorted out for you! Please don't hesitate to reach back out if anything else comes up — we're always happy to help.

Have a wonderful {{time_of_day}}!

commands.name: AI-Draft Reply (CS)
commands.description: AI reads the highlighted message and drafts a customer service response
commands.aiPrompt:
You are a warm, professional customer service representative.

A customer sent the following message:
---
{{selectedText}}
---

Draft a helpful, empathetic reply. Be concise (3–5 sentences). Do not use hollow filler phrases like 'Great question!' or 'Absolutely!'. Do not add a subject line. Just write the reply body.

commands.name: Sincere Apology
commands.description: Acknowledge a mistake or bad experience without deflecting
commands.template:
Hi {{name}},

I sincerely apologize for {{issue}}. This is not the experience we aim to provide, and I completely understand your frustration.

I've {{action_taken}} to make this right, and I want to assure you this is being taken seriously. Please let me know if there is anything else I can do — your satisfaction matters greatly to us.

variables.label: What you've done to fix it

commands.name: Service Delay Apology
commands.description: Acknowledge a delayed delivery, response, or service
commands.template:
Hi {{name}},

I want to sincerely apologize for the delay with {{what_was_delayed}}. We fell short of the standard you deserve, and I'm sorry for any inconvenience this caused.

Your {{what_was_delayed}} is now expected {{new_eta}}. I'm personally keeping an eye on this and will update you immediately if anything changes.

Thank you for your patience — we truly appreciate it.

commands.name: Goodwill Compensation Offer
commands.description: Offer a credit, discount, or gesture to an unhappy customer
commands.template:
Hi {{name}},

Again, I'm truly sorry for the experience you had with {{issue}}. We want to make this right.

As a goodwill gesture, I'd like to offer you {{offer}}. I've applied this to your account and it's ready to use.

We value your loyalty and hope this helps restore your confidence in us. Please reach out any time — we're here for you.

variables.label: Compensation Offered
options: a 10% discount on your next order
a full refund for this transaction
one month free on your subscription

commands.name: Escalation Acknowledgement
commands.description: Acknowledge a complaint that's been escalated to a supervisor or senior team
commands.template:
Hi {{name}},

Thank you for bringing this to our attention, and I want you to know your concern has been escalated to {{escalated_to}}. They will be reviewing your case personally and will be in touch within {{timeframe}}.

You have my word that this is being handled with the urgency it deserves. I'm sorry again for the trouble this has caused.

commands.name: AI-Draft Recovery Response
commands.description: AI reads an upset customer message and drafts an empathetic service recovery reply
commands.aiPrompt:
You are a senior customer service manager specializing in service recovery.

An upset customer sent the following message:
---
{{selectedText}}
---

Draft a service recovery response that:
1. Opens with a genuine, specific apology (not generic)
2. Acknowledges exactly what went wrong without excuses
3. States a concrete next step to fix the problem
4. Closes warmly and reassures the customer

Tone: empathetic, calm, professional. 4–6 sentences. No hollow phrases like 'We apologize for any inconvenience.' Write the reply body only.

commands.name: Explain a Charge
commands.description: Clarify what a specific charge on the customer's account is for
commands.template:
Hi {{name}},

Thank you for reaching out about the {{amount}} charge on {{date}}. I'm happy to clarify!

This charge corresponds to {{explanation}}. You can view the full breakdown in your account under {{location}}.

If this still doesn't look right or you have further questions, please let me know — I'm glad to dig deeper.

variables.label: Where to find it (e.g. Billing History)

commands.name: Refund Approved
commands.description: Confirm a refund has been issued and set timeline expectations
commands.template:
Hi {{name}},

Great news — I've processed a refund of {{amount}} to your {{payment_method}}. Please allow {{timeline}} for it to appear, depending on your bank's processing time.

You'll receive a confirmation email shortly. If you don't see the refund after {{timeline}}, please reach back out and we'll investigate immediately.

commands.name: Refund Not Approved
commands.description: Decline a refund request clearly and empathetically
commands.template:
Hi {{name}},

Thank you for getting in touch, and I'm sorry to hear about your experience.

After reviewing your account, I'm unable to process a refund in this instance because {{reason}}. Our refund policy covers {{policy_summary}}, and unfortunately this request falls outside those terms.

I understand this may be disappointing and I'm sorry I can't do more here. If you'd like to discuss further options, I'm happy to help in any way I can.

commands.name: Payment Failed Notice
commands.description: Alert the customer to a failed payment and guide next steps
commands.template:
Hi {{name}},

I'm reaching out because we weren't able to process your most recent payment of {{amount}} on {{date}}.

To avoid any interruption to your {{service}}, please update your payment information at your earliest convenience: {{payment_link}}

If you believe this is an error or your card was charged, please contact your bank — sometimes transactions are declined at the bank level. I'm happy to help troubleshoot further if needed.

commands.name: Subscription Cancellation Confirm
commands.description: Confirm a cancellation and communicate access end date
commands.template:
Hi {{name}},

I've processed your cancellation as requested. Your {{plan}} subscription will remain active through {{end_date}}, after which your account will revert to our free tier.

You won't be charged again. If you change your mind before {{end_date}}, you can reactivate at any time from your account settings.

We're sorry to see you go — if there's anything that would have made your experience better, we'd genuinely love to hear it.

commands.name: Upgrade Confirmation
commands.description: Confirm a plan upgrade and highlight what's now unlocked
commands.template:
Hi {{name}},

Welcome to {{new_plan}}! Your upgrade is active and all new features are unlocked on your account right now.

Here's what you now have access to:
{{features}}

If you have any questions getting started, don't hesitate to reach out. We're excited to have you on {{new_plan}}!

commands.name: AI-Draft Billing Response
commands.description: AI reads a billing question and drafts a clear, professional response
commands.aiPrompt:
You are a professional billing support specialist.

A customer sent the following billing inquiry:
---
{{selectedText}}
---

Draft a clear, professional response that:
1. Directly addresses their question or concern
2. Explains any charges, policies, or next steps in plain language
3. Offers a concrete resolution or clear next step
4. Is empathetic if they're frustrated

Tone: professional, clear, reassuring. 4–6 sentences. No hollow filler phrases. Reply body only.
